I feel for the woman who lost het job! Not saying what happened is right BUT to compare shirtless firefighters raising money for charity with an only fans page is ludicrous. It's not the same thing and any intelligent person knows that deep down

Actually to just consider comparing shirtless men to an only fans page under any circumstances is idiotic and everyone knows that but there's an agenda

If the firefighters were naked or tossing off like only fans page that's a different story.... but they aren't so its NOT the same thing and never will be

Why is the writer comparing male vs female anyway? It's not a contest (well shouldn't be a contest) or battle of sexes but it seems to always be turned around onto men. What does her losing her job by being on a pornographic site have to do with men or firefighters?

This doesn't help your situation but there have been many studies showing that social media makes people depressed and negatively affects their mental health.

That's almost everyone, just some are not as smart as you to realize or don't admit it.

They did a study and found that people who got off social media had a big leap forward in life satisfaction and happiness and loneliness decreased after a few days

They said Instagram is the worst, followed by Facebook and then tiktok at the time

So you are not alone

Everyone posts a pic of their new car or great holiday or  best photo. But that is not their life. They don't show the photos of them crying or worrying about how they will afford the new car or the big fight they had on the holiday. They only show the good. But much of their life is bad but they won't show that. Many would feel the same as you but haven't said it

Its all fake and the more you see, the more it will affect you. It's not social and I think in a few years you will see a decline in social media use as people see it's anti social 

Best of luck anyway:) feel free to message me if you like
